verdicts.reason: A: the 'WEEKEND ONLY' kicker sits flush to the canvas edge, but the '20% off' headline is indented, so they don't share an edge. The headline nearly touches the body copy, and the product is shrunk to a tiny icon after the CTA. The legal line is squeezed into a ragged 5-line column jammed against the right edge, on top of the peach circle. B: kicker, headline and body share a clean left edge, and the order runs left to right through product in circle, then CTA, then legal, which reads well. Its flaws: the headline is cramped against the body copy, and the legal line under the CTA is too small to read at this size.
